author: Nicola S-B
content: I hired the Sealife Ball Pond for my little girl's 1st birthday on Saturday and I was very pleased with the service I received. The delivery people were on time, polite and helpful. The whole process from booking to the actual party ran quite smoothly and Lopez was available to answer all of my emails very promptly. I'd definitely recommend Dancing Cubs and use them again in the future. Thanks guys!﻿
